notes.title: New Major Update! v1.05 is Here!
notes.content:
Another update is here Racers! v1.05 completely changes the game in a lot of ways. Here's a list of patch notes.

[list]
[*] Can now adjust camera height for both players.
[*] Can toggle if camera auto zooms or not.
[*] Can now toggle on or off the Mouse Steering Tether graphic.
[*] Fixed graphical issues on the warping ships in Track 08.
[*] Improved performance in Track 06.
[*] Fixed bug in leaderboard showing wrong display. 
[*] Fixed leaderboard UI issues.
[*] Translation updates
[/list]

Each track has been updated to be easier to navigate, and the new camera height options can give you exactly the view that's right for you. 

Unfortunately, each track has had enough changes to warrant their time trial records being reset to compensate for the changes. Which means a leaderboard reset. If you've already completed the time trial challenge, you will see keep any unlocks.

notes.title: First Major Update. Galaxy Drift v1.04 released.
notes.content:
Hello Racers!

Galaxy Drift v1.04 is here! Here's a quick rundown.

[u][b] Additional Languages: [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese.
[/list]
[u][b]Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed broken defaults button in control options.
[*] Using mouse steering in two-player mode should now work in Fullscreen or Windowed.
[*] Player positions in two-player split screen are now shown on the bottom left.
[*] Increased visibility of certain HUD elements.
[*] Modified HUD elements to better scale above 1920x1080.
[*] Space based tracks now have the proper speed increase when intended.
[*] Added Steam Cloud save support.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Galaxy Drift v1.03
notes.content:
Version 1.03 Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that could cause background ships to not appear.
[*] In Single Player and Grand Prix, the player's name is now user's Steam name if connected, rather than the generic 'Player One.'
[*] Improved directional arrow and health orb visibility.
[/list]

Thank you,
JustusGames

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Small patch to address the tutorial and menu navigation.

Changes:
[list]

[*] Revamped tutorial. Should now be easier to read the tutorial messages. Also improved tutorial messages for each control type.
[*] Improved menu navigation. You can now use ESC key or controller to go to previous menu. Added confirm on exit game in pause menu.
[/list]
